shared_elements: figural imagery on a rock surface
justification: Both surfaces carry figural imagery on rock including human-related forms, a profile quadruped (in B) and a repeated series of small units (a row of crew-strokes in B, a column of glyph blocks in A), but these correspondences are generic. A shows densely modelled, overlapping seated/reclining figures with elaborate costume beside columns of square sign-blocks, while B shows a starkly schematic silhouette boat with upcurved prow and stern, stick-crew and a small isolated animal — utterly different depictive conventions and subject matter.
